clips.title: The story
paras: Sten Stoutarm is a practical dwarven outfitter and courier stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Responsible for keeping new recruits equipped and managing local dispatches, he helps ensure that novice mountaineers stay warm, fed, and informed despite the harsh mountain conditions.

Positioned near the heart of Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm is one of the first friendly faces new dwarven and gnomish recruits encounter outside Anvilmar's tavern. With the valley isolated by winter blizzards and encroaching dangers, Sten takes it upon himself to outfit green apprentices with sturdy gear before they freeze or wander unprepared into the drifts.

Beyond assembling winter outfitting from local wolf hides, Sten serves as an informal postmaster for Coldridge Valley. He handles messages passed through the treacherous Coldridge Pass and distributes official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers throughout the basin, ensuring novice warriors, priests, and mages get their instructions despite the hostile trogg presence blocking the tunnels.
